_doc: Captured live 2026-10-18 by the PR4 probe (dimagi-internal/ace optional labs E2E). Private throwaway solicitation 1000003 owned by ace-pm-org (labs org 352 / Connect org 386) on program 308, closed after the probe, nothing awarded. ace-nm-org (labs org 353 / Connect org 387) stood in for the ACE winner org. Pins spec § K1: award_response.org_id is the winner's CONNECT organisation integer id as a string (connect-labs origin/main connect_labs/mcp/tools/solicitations.py award_response schema: 'The winning organisation's CONNECT organisation id (Connect's integer id, as a string) ... it is not a labs organisation pk or slug, and it does not choose who is awarded: the response's own organisation (its llo_entity) is the awardee'). create_response persists org_id as given (response 1000049); without it the response's org_id is '' (1000048). When org_name is omitted on a bound response, labs fills org_name from submitted_by_name (1000048) — so always pass org_name. Owner seeding accepts a response missing a required answer (1000047) and accepts a second response for the same llo_entity (1000048, 1000049): idempotency is the caller's job.
award_response_org_id_source: connect-labs origin/main connect_labs/mcp/tools/solicitations.py (award_response input schema, org_id description), shipped in jjackson/connect-labs#2605: org_id is the winner's CONNECT organisation id as a string, recorded as given; the response's own org (llo_entity) decides the awardee. create_response llo_entity_id takes the labs org slug (Connect slug or id also accepted).
